Title: One environment per project
Body: Create a virtual environment for every project and commit the dependency list or lock file. Shared global installs cause the dreaded 'works on my machine'.

Title: Use type hints at the boundaries
Body: Annotate public functions and data models. You get editor help and a checker that finds bugs, and tools like Pydantic can validate real input.

Title: Format and lint automatically
Body: Let Ruff format and lint on save and in CI so reviews never debate style.

Title: Do not put work in import time
Body: Importing a module should define things, not connect to databases or read files. Put side effects in functions called from `main`.

Title: Prefer pathlib and context managers
Body: Use `pathlib.Path` for paths and `with` for files and connections so cleanup is guaranteed.
